ui_accessibility_analysis.problem: The `isLoading` div is fixed to the viewport using `inset-0`, `fixed`, and `bg-opacity-20`. This prevents the user from interacting with any part of the application while loading, effectively blocking the UI and causing a critical UX issue.
ui_accessibility_analysis.original_code:
v-if="isLoading"
    class="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-20 z-50 flex items-center justify-center"
ui_accessibility_analysis.fixed_code:
v-if="isLoading"
    class="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-20 z-50 flex items-center justify-center"
    style="margin: 0;"
ui_accessibility_analysis.explanation: Removing `inset-0` and `fixed` will allow the loading div to be replaced by the actual content.  Adding `margin: 0` will allow the loading div to be contained by its parent div. This resolves the blocked UI issue.
ui_accessibility_analysis.fix_diff:
--- original
+++ fixed
@@ -14 +14 @@
-    class="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-20 z-50 flex items-center justify-center"
+    class="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-20 z-50 flex items-center justify-center margin: 0;"
